interface.name: tilo_input_context_manager_v1
interface.description: An application may declare canonical bound action references for its own surface. Only the currently focused non-sensitive text field is eligible. The compositor resolves every reference through the ordinary certified action catalogue.

request.name: publish

description.summary: replace this surface's bounded focused-field snapshot

request.description: The JSON snapshot carries a private generation, route and canonical action references with bound arguments. No text value is required. A newer snapshot replaces the previous one; an empty snapshot clears it. It grants no permissions.

interface.name: tilo_input_context_keyboard_v1
interface.description: This global is visible only to the compositor-authenticated input-method owner. The keyboard receives labels and opaque slots, never app addresses or arguments. Invocation rechecks focus, sensitivity, generation and canonical owner admission.
